artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G - Financial Accounting & Invariant Verification

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Double-Entry Balance Sheet Conservation
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Verified on every single session across all 20 synthetic stress regimes for both Frozen E0 and Candidate D2.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Non-Negative Cash Invariant (Zero Broker Margin Debt)
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: Cash >= -1e-6 (No debit balances, no margin loan borrowing)
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: PortfolioState cash balance remained strictly non-negative throughout all stress regimes, confirming 100% cash funding.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Order Rejection Position Invariance
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: If order is rejected or invalid, positions[ticker] and cash must remain exactly identical to pre-order state
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Exercised in Scenario 9: 100 shares of INVALID_XYZ and -50 shares of AAPL rejected with zero state corruption.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Failed Sell Holding Protection
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: If sell order fails or is cancelled, existing share quantity cannot be decreased
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Exercised in Scenario 11: Queue cancellation left existing long positions completely intact.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Dividend Imputation & Settlement Parity
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: On ex-date, dividend receivable is created; on payment date (T+10), receivable becomes cash; total equity is conserved
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Exercised in Scenario 12: $1.50 SPY and $0.85 AAPL dividends credited with zero double-counting.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Stock Split Conservation
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: Shares multiply by S, cost basis divides by S; total market value is invariant at split execution instant
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Exercised in Scenario 13 (2:1 NVDA split) and Scenario 19 (4:1 AAPL revision) with zero artificial P&L shock.

accounting_invariants_audited.name: Long-Only Invariant
accounting_invariants_audited.formula: For all i, positions_i >= 0 (Zero short positions)
accounting_invariants_audited.proof: Verified that neither strategy emits short sell orders under any synthetic market condition.

reconciliation_e0_vs_d2.risk_on_parity: When SPY and QQQ are in confirmed uptrends, E0 and D2 generate 100% identical target weights, orders, and equity curves.
reconciliation_e0_vs_d2.risk_off_divergence: When market regime flips to defensive, D2 holds exactly 50% cash and 50% sector ETFs, while E0 holds 20% cash and 80% sector ETFs.
